title: SOC analyst needs E5 (Defender for Endpoint, PIM) but E5 seats are exhausted
narrative: Security Operations hires an analyst who needs Defender for Endpoint and PIM-eligible Security Reader. LAB_M365_E5 shows 15/15 seats consumed, so adding the user to GRP-LIC-E5-SECOPS would leave a group licensing CountViolation. The role request is also flagged: it must be PIM-eligible, not permanent.

auditEvidence.source: Procurement request for 5 additional E5 seats (synthetic)
